step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows Redbus's user-generated content (UGC) dynamic tagging pipeline. Users interact via various channels (UserConsumerWebMobile) to submit feedback/reviews through an API endpoint (EC2). This raw unstructured data is saved in an Arango DB graph database (ThirdParty). Amazon SageMaker (SageMaker) uses this data for managed model training (using scikit-learn random forest via BYOA, tuned via HPO) and batch transform, writing the generated dynamic tags back into Arango DB.

API writes raw user reviews into Arango DB.
Arango DB data is fed into SageMaker for training and batch processing.
SageMaker Batch Transform outputs generated dynamic tags back to Arango DB.
